label: Biometric Device ID
description: Employee ID as registered on the biometric device
name: Employee-slhrm_biometric_device_id

label: Eligible for Overtime
description: Only eligible employees get OT in Attendance Marker and Payroll Worksheet.
name: Employee-slhrm_ot_eligible

label: Allow Check-in via App
description: Lets this employee check in/out from the SLHRM app. Also requires HR Settings > Allow Employee Checkin from Mobile App.
name: Employee-slhrm_allow_app_checkin

label: SLHRM: Must Change Password
description: Set when SLHRM gives the user a random temporary password. While set (and the user has not changed the password since), Desk/PWA redirect to /update-password and API calls return 403. Cleared automatically after a real password change.
name: User-slhrm_must_change_password

label: Managed by SLHRM
description: If checked, this SSA is managed by Employee Salary Package. Do not edit manually.
name: Salary Structure Assignment-slhrm_managed

label: Employee Salary Package
description: Link to the Employee Salary Package that manages this SSA.
name: Salary Structure Assignment-slhrm_package_link

label: Counts toward EPF/ETF base
description: SLHRM: the final (prorated, post-package) amount of this earning is part of the EPF/ETF base.
name: Salary Component-slhrm_epf_applicable

label: Rate on EPF base
description: SLHRM: amount = EPF/ETF base x rate / 100, replacing the structure formula value. Statistical components are shown as employer lines (never in totals).
name: Salary Component-slhrm_epf_rate

label: Package components (snapshot)
description: SLHRM: Employee Salary Package rows in force from this assignment's From Date. Salary Slips of periods using this assignment apply these amounts.
name: Salary Structure Assignment-slhrm_package_components

label: EPF No.
description: SLHRM: Employees' Provident Fund member number (from HR).
name: Employee-slhrm_epf_no

label: Reduces EPF base and APIT taxable
description: SLHRM: this deduction (e.g. No Pay entered as Additional Salary) is subtracted from the EPF base and from the APIT taxable amount.
name: Salary Component-slhrm_reduces_epf_base

label: APIT exempt
description: SLHRM: no APIT is deducted (non-resident / special cases).
name: Employee-slhrm_apit_exempt
